description.value: Spice Republic Indian Restaurant & Lounge is a full-service Indian restaurant in Surrey offering traditional and contemporary Indian cuisine in a stylish dining space with both indoor and outdoor seating. The restaurant emphasizes authentic spices and bold flavors, catering to relaxed lunches, intimate dinners, and group outings. Online ordering, pickup, and delivery within 15 km are available, making it a potential meal stop for cyclists in the area.
